comment_scale.1: accurate relevant explanation with important coverage missing or contradicted elsewhere
comment_scale.2: accurately explains core non-obvious constraint and its rationale or boundary

organization_scale.0: missing applicable behavior or severe issue
organization_scale.1: maintainable in part with material cost or gaps
organization_scale.2: clear boundary or design with concrete code support

quality.method: Manual source quality grading from public checkpoint requirements and persisted source only. No reference solutions, official test code, or test outcomes used. Scores are not correctness, runtime or memory measurements. Comment tokens include all tokenize.COMMENT values such as shebangs, section rules and type directives; counts are descriptive only. Prior rubric kept for both lanes; the preflight-failed manifest fixture is excluded from paired quality. Local targeted probes use only candidate source, documented requirements and original small inputs.

limitations: One trajectory per mode on one benchmark task. This run uses its official tests, not an official leaderboard run.
Each checkpoint receives its own lane’s prior code bytes. Native first submissions and capped snapshots are evaluated, not a full Building-loop audit closure.
The two modes share the updated comment guidance. Cross-version differences mix the workflow change and this prompt change.
Time spent solving and execution time of correct code are distinct. Performance workloads require matching reference event digests.
Source snapshots, upstream fixtures and reference solutions remain in the local experiment directory.
